'''HN Group Management''' is the company that holds the assets of [[HN Group]]. It owns the group's domains, Discord servers and technical assets, and manages all of HN Group's email services.

{{Company ownership|HN Group Management}}

== Role ==
HN Group Management keeps the things the whole group relies on in one place, separate from the companies that trade:

* '''Domains''' — the group's web and email domains
* '''Discord servers''' — the group's Discord communities
* '''Technical assets''' — the systems and other technical assets used across the group
* '''Email services''' — it manages email for HN Group and its companies

It doesn't have a website of its own; it is described on the [https://hngroup.org.uk/companies HN Group website].

== Staff and management ==
HN Group Management has no staff of its own. It is managed directly by the staff of [[HN Group]].

== Structure ==
{{Company tree}}

== Brand ==
[[File:hn-group-management-roundel.svg|thumb|The HN Group Management roundel]]
HN Group Management's logo is a thick indigo ring containing its initials, '''HGM''', alongside the company name, in the same style as the Horizon companies' roundels. It is a separate logo from HN Group's: it is not a substitute for the HN Group wordmark.
